text: Iron-In-Blood is an Argonian weaponsmith in who sells various weapons and resides with Muranatepa at the stall "Blood is not Rust" in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants, Bal Foyen.
Irasil Hedoren is a Dunmer residing in the city of Mournhold.
Iron-Claws is an Argonian residing in the region of Bal Foyen. He can be found looking over the fields in the region just northeast of Fort Zeren. After completing his task, he relocates in Dhalmora.
Irghild Cold-Moon is a Nord innkeeper running her family inn in Windhelm.
Io-Io is an Argonian traveling merchant found on the road east of Ebonheart or at Vivec's Antlers. She travels alongside Caravaneer Iggistill.
Irgazdul is a Khajiit slave found in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Irgun is a Khajiit mage competing in The Sorcerer Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Iriel is an Altmer found in Mathiisen. She is the mother of Vareldur, who is missing.
Iron-Heel is an Argonian pirate who is a part of Captain Blackheart's crew. He is the first miniboss in Blackheart Haven.
Iron Head is a named crocodile boss found inside Hircine's Haunt, in the region of Craglorn.
Ironbark is a dog residing in Vulkhel Guard. He can be found at the bottom of the stairs in front of the Fighters Guild hall, being watched over by Apprentice Odrethin.
Iron Orc Bruiser is a generic Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs faction.
Iron Orc Butcher is a generic Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs faction.
Iron Orc Ranger is a generic Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs faction.
Iron Orc Thundermaul is a generic Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs faction.
Iron Orc Ravager is a generic Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs faction.
Iranya is an Altmer residing at her house in the town of Shattered Grove, Auridon.
Irileth Trandel is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Iocani Medilus is an Imperial stylemaster. She sells her wares at The Howling Forge at The Crafter's Square in Kvatch.
Iragahr is a Khajiit member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Irbjar is a Nord member of the Ternion Monks found in Mistwatch.

The Iron Hound Alchemist is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Archer is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Bruiser is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Brute is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Hooligan is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Stalker is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.

The Iron Hound Ravager is a generic character located in multiple locations in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Iron Hound faction, and they are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a disguise is worn.
Alveno Apo is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. He does not have any unique dialogue.
Irinja was one of the serving maids working in Sathil castle. Despite appearing to be an innocent girl, she spied on Attrebus for Lady Sathil.
Iozukeeus is an Argonian farmer of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. She has no unique dialogue.
Iratan the Lightbringer is a Mournful Aegis that appears in . It is found at the Shrine of the Reforged in Southern Elsweyr. Iratan is an Auroran variant of Mournful Aegises and thus serves Meridia.
Irncifel the Despoiler is a Havocrel boss that appears in . He can be found wandering around the Deadlands.

Ja-Kha'jay is a god in the Khajiiti pantheon. He is also known as the Lunar Lattice. His motions supposedly protect Nirni from Ahnurr's anger, as he cannot cross the lattice. Some sources state that Nirni dances along with the Ja-Kha'jay, as evidenced by the tide's ebb and flow moving in accordance with the moons. One aspect of him is Jode (Big Moon God). Jode is also known as Masser or Mara's Tear. Another aspect is Jone (Little Moon God): Aldmeri god of the Little Moon. Jone is also called Secunda or Stendarr's Sorrow.

Itar the Gentle is a Nord Commoner living in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. He wears common clothing and carries a key to his home. Itar is never at home but can be found wandering in the walled courtyard between The End of the World and the Watch Tower.
Irwaen is a Bosmer Sharpshooter living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Jamie is a Redguard crusader residing at the tradehouse in the town of Suran.
Isa Raman is an Imperial spell merchant at the Great Chapel of Talos in Bruma.

Itius Hayn is a Guard Captain in the Imperial City. He is known to be "loyal, but not too bright" by his superiors, and has a strong sense of law and duty. He plays a role in the quest "Imperial Corruption."
Ja'Fazir is the Khajiit second-in-command of the Blackwood Company. When the Hero arrives at the Blackwood Company, Ja'Fazir will approach them.

J'baana is a Khajiit that is imprisoned in the Legion Headquarters, Imperial City. While an inmate, he can be found with keys stolen from the guards, making it hard to contain him. He is also the Master level Security trainer.
J'Baasha is a Khajiit bandit member of Mogens Wind-Shifter's Bandits.

Isleif the Open Handed is a Redguard who lives in Jair's Shack in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. Isleif is a member of the Thieves Guild. He is rarely seen anywhere but wandering the Waterfront and occasionally in other districts of the Imperial City.
Iulus Truptor is an Imperial savant residing in the city of Ebonheart. He is usually found in the Imperial Chapels of Castle Ebonheart. He is also initiate of the Imperial Cult.
J'Zhirr is a Khajiit agent living in Ebonheart. He is an employee of the East Empire Company and resides at the East Empire Company Hall. He is also a trainer in three skills.

J'zargo is a Khajiit apprentice at the College of Winterhold in . He is a potential follower and is eligible to become a member of the Blades. When not accompanying the Dragonborn, he can be found at the College of Winterhold either in the Hall of Attainment or the Hall of the Elements.
J'darr is a Khajiit in the Alftand glacial ruins. He has long since been driven mad by Skooma withdrawals, and is standing next to the body of his brother, J'zhar.
J'zhar is a deceased Khajiit found in Alftand. His brother J'darr has been suffering from a skooma addiction.
Istar Cairn-Breaker is a Nord warrior and a Commander of the Stormcloaks.

Jala is a Nord food vendor residing in the city of Solitude. She is typically found at her stand selling produce during waking hours, and in her house at night. She is living together with Ahtar, with whom she is in a relationship.
J'Kier is a Khajiit member of the Hunters of Hircine, who is found dying in the latter part of the quest "Ill Met by Moonlight." He cannot be saved, even with the use of Healing Hands or Heal Other.

J'zidzo is a Khajiit thief who resides in the Shivering Isles in the settlement of Split. He shares his name with a Mania version of himself in the same town. Despite having the same name and appearance, they share no other traits besides their hatred for each other.
Issmi is a Golden Saint and a commander of a small force of Golden Saints at Brellach.
Isabeau Bienne is a Breton ostler who sells Bay Horses at the Bay Roan Stables outside Bravil.

J'datharr is a Khajiit assassin waiting outside of Windhelm, behind the stables. He is sent by the Thalmor to kill Malborn after the completion of the quest "Diplomatic Immunity," before he can flee Skyrim. He carries a note addressed to him. Since he is not part of a Khajiit caravan, killing J'datharr will incur no bounty, even if witnessed by the other Khajiit. Hold Guards will not react to any assault towards him either, and may actually help in killing him.
Istirus Brolus is a Breton rogue, and resides in his house with his wife, Jantus Brolus, in the city of Bruma.
J'mhad is a Khajiit residing in the Imperial City. J'mhad is the groundskeeper of the Temple of the One in the Arboretum, and can be most often found there.

Itermerel is an Altmer mage. Although Itermerel is a member of the Mages Guild, and lives in Balmora, he does not reside in the Mages Guild hall. Instead, he lives at Eight Plates, and, after his quest, can be found in Pelagiad.
Irver Fevur is a Dunmer commoner who lives in Ald'ruhn. He can be found in Venim Manor.
Irvama Othrelas is a Dunmer herder who resides at the Gro-Bagrat Plantation close to Vivec City. She works as a netch herder for the Gro-Bagrat Plantation.
Irvsie Othran is a Dunmer sorcerer who resides in the Arena of Rotheran. She carries the Rotheran slave key with her.
Iveri Llothri is a Dunmer Witch who resides in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Ivrosa Verethi is a Dunmer master-at-arms and member of the Thieves Guild residing on the Dren Plantation.
Jake is a dog who belongs to Perennia Draconis and can be found in Applewatch. He follows her around almost contently. The only times she is alone is when she goes outside and he remains indoors.
J'Hanir is a Khajiit found at Fort Firemoth. He tells the Nerevarine he was left behind when the fort was overrun, and that he survived by eating the mines' mushrooms.
Isobel is a hagraven found in . She is the sister of Ettiene and Fallaise.
Jakarn is a Breton rogue who is imprisoned in the Grave outside Port Hunding, on the island of Stros M'Kai.

Ivulen Irano is a Dunmer guard who serves in the Royal Guard. He can be found in the throne room of the Royal Palace in Mournhold. He is also the author of the Handwritten note. He uses a full set of Royal Guard Armor for protection.
J'Dato is a Khajiit Slave who resides in Abebaal Egg Mine. J'Dato, as well as the rest of the slaves in the mine, is owned by House Telvanni and is in the middle of a revolt.
J'Jazha is a Khajiit slave residing in the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.
Ius, God of Animals, also known as Ius the Agitated and Ius the Extremely Agitated, is a deity worshiped in Valenwood, Hammerfell, and Elsweyr.

Jakidi is a Nord ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned to the temple. She will say that is searching for her ribcage when the Vestige talks to her.
Jacqueline Gilbeau is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She can be seen walking around town.
J'Dhannar is a Khajiit pauper who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
J'Raksa is an Khajiit slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
J'Ram-Dar is an Argonian slave held captive in the cave of Hinnabi.
Jalfrid Lodorrsbane is a Draugr champion of the Hall of the Dead public dungeon. Killing her counts towards the "Hall of the Dead Vanquisher" and "Hall of the Dead Conquerer" achievements.
Jafrost Cold-Eye is a Nord grocer. She sells her wares at her stall, Chillwind Chuck Wagon, at the Dockside Trading Stalls in the Stonetooth Fortress.
Ithis Omalor is a Dunmer of House Dres found in Mzithumz. He is the who orchestrated the ambush on a Hlaalu caravan that was passing by the ruins.

Jalienna is a Redguard who resides in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is spending her days in the Boarding House opposite Port Hunding's Open Marketplace with three others; Deetwos, Uggnath, and Vingarion.
Jadier Mannick is a Breton slave who resides in Tel Aruhn. He can be purchased for 1000 gold and will aid the Nerevarine in battle.
Isunie is an Altmer residing in the Auridon region of the Summerset Isles.
J'Ffer, also spelt J'ffer, is a Khajiit in . He owns the shop J'ffer's Books.
Isiraamo is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild. He is the magister of their branch in Belkarth.
Izandar is a Khajiit slave and bard performing at The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Iteldil is an Altmer woodworker in who resides at his stall Old Mill Woodcrafted Weaponry in the city of Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost.
Jalamya is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found on Eyevea.
Izishir is a Khajiit mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Rawl'kha. He is found at the local branch selling his wares.
Jalaima is a Redguard guild trader residing in the Baandari Trading Post.
Isramal Cedmain is a Redguard residing in the city of Wayrest.
Iulianus the Footsore is an Imperial residing in the city of Sentinel.
Irwad is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel. He is patron of the Sisters of the Sands Inn, one of the two inns located in the city of Sentinel.
Jalinah is a Redguard laborer residing in the Tanners and Miners Hall in the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Jaddveig Owlcloak is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is the hall steward of their guildhall in Hoarfrost Downs.
Islaif the Highwayman is a Redguard ghost found in the Tears of the Dishonored.
Irvic is a Breton found in Daggerfall. He resides in his house with Ursyvyra Lavergne.

Isabeth Gaercroft is a Breton member of the Evermore City Guard and the daughter of Eugien Gaercroft. She can be found in the basement of Duraeg's House, with Duraeg performing a ritual to turn her into a Bloodthorn Zombie.
Ishalga is a Khajiit and the current grand champion of the Thizzrini Arena.
Israk Ice-Storm is a Nord soldier of the Pact who was caught along with his brother Nathon while spying on the bandits at Faldar's Tooth.
Isrudde Crows-Watch is a Nord scavenger found at the Crossroads Encampment in Craglorn.
Issal is a Redguard miner that worked the Kulati Mines before it was invaded by spiders.
Issayarul is a Dunmer Ashlander member of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Ittir Jaggedpeak is a Nord patron of the Fish Head Tavern in Lower Yorgrim.

Iwelien is a dead Altmer found in the catacombs of Phaer. He was the son of Velatosse and the younger brother of Nelulin and one of the first to be put in quarantine. Even though he is dead, he may still be interacted with.
Izandskar is a Khajiit residing inside Silat's house at the Windcatcher Plantation.
Iziran is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He is found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Izzara is a Redguard mage trapped in the Nilata Ruins, Bangkorai, along with her twin sister Adeena in .
J'darzi is a Khajiit merchant of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, J'darzi's Fine Imports, in the Marketplace of Riften.
Ja-Reet is a mute Argonian found at the Percolating Mire. He was born away from the Hist, disadvantaging him in Argonian society.
Jacquebeth Favret is a Breton patron of The Run Inn in Fell's Run.
Jada is a Redguard stablemaster and owner of the Bell and Bridle in Belkarth.
Jadvar is a Nord member of the Ternion Monks tending to King Jorunn in Mistwatch.
Jaema is a Nord soldier of the Pact found in Jorunn's Stand. She is Thane Oda Wolf-Sister's housecarl.
Jahadar is a deceased Redguard member of the Mages Guild found in the Shademist Moors.
Jahlasri is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers found at their camp in northern Greenshade.
Jainda is a Khajiit merchant of the Baandari Clan. She sells her wares at her stall, Jainda's Needful Supplies, at the stalls of their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Jakirfa is a Nord patron of The Shining Star in the Hollow City.
Jalarma Fireheart is a Nord Companion encountered as a ghost deep within Shor's Stone's mine.
Izzunath the Corrupter is a powerful Skeleton found inside the Ruins of Kardala.
Ivrosa Telvanni is a Dunmer Noble and member of House Telvanni residing in Kragenmoor, Stonefalls. She has no unique dialogue.

Jaganvir is the current Arch-Mage of the Stros M'Kai Mages Guild in . He gained his position after Arch-Mage Voa was killed in the Battle of Hunding Bay. He is considered by others in the guild to be an Imperial collaborator and unworthy successor. When not locking himself away with the Upper Cabal, he studies insistently for the Battlespire and has no time nor patience for the concerns of "mundanes" (non-magic users).
Ithanarth was a Bosmer residing in Deepwoods. He was kidnapped and killed by nearby Houndsmen and his corpse can be found at their camp near the village.
Isabeau Jend is a Breton found inside the castle in Daggerfall.
Isara Fralinie is a Breton residing in Riften. She is a potential assassination target in The Rift.
Ivaynel Amurith is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Jakja is an Imperial hailing from Anvil. She was captured by the vampire lord Zalar-do and brought to her lair within Hrota Cave.
J'Eeja is a Khajiit merchant selling his wares at his camp near Alessia Bridge.
Ivulen Andromo is a Dunmer historian who is found in the center of the Saint Olms Waistworks, which is on the upper level of the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City.
Izaniran is a Khajiit drunkard residing in Balmora, in the region of Vvardenfell.
Ivela Telvanni is a Dunmer tailor working at Telvanni Tailors, a stall in the Tailors and Dyers Hall within the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City.
Jackdaw Menders are enemies that can be encountered in Haven before the completion of "Unsafe Haven." This enemy is a member of the Jackdaw Pirates.
Jackdaw Sentinels are enemies encountered in Haven before the completion of "Unsafe Haven." This enemy is a member of the Jackdaw Pirates.

Ixtah-Nasha is a mentioned character in . He is Mere-Glim's cousin. He saw Umbriel approach Lilmoth from his boat. His crew and him outspaced Umbriel for three days before they got the wind needed to leave the city behind.

Irsusah is a Khajiit sitting in front of a fireplace on the ground floor of Nyderion's Boarding Home in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. Since entering the house is considered trespassing, she may be hostile to the Vestige while inside. She has no unique dialogue.
Jairry at-Dolmir is a Redguard residing in the city of Kozanset.
Irvic Thielde is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Jaeloreh is a deceased Redguard merchant located on a rocky peak above Nikolvara's Kennel. She was the lover of Nammadin and sister to Travofia.
Izanden is a Khajiit Battlegrounds Furnisher in who is found at the Gladiator's Quarters in Vulken Guard, Auridon.
Iskenaaz is an Argonian of the Bright-Throat Tribe and the apprentice of Tree-Minder Pavu who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Isadati is a Khajiit residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.
J'luk is a Khajiit zither player residing at in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.
Jaffridde is a Nord residing in Hjotund's House in Solitude.
Irthvyd the Impassive was a Jarl and later High King of Skyrim during the First Era.

Ivgrizt is a Goblin that can initially be found in the Twilight Temple in . After being helped by the Hero, he moves to Fearfrost Caverns where he waits for the Hero to come claim Olpac Trailslag's pack.
Jaleel is a Redguard siege instructor of the Daggerfall Covenant. He is located due north of the Southern High Rock Gate, at the siege range.
Jeanne Frasoric is a Breton Sorcerer who lives in Bruma. She is in charge of running the Bruma chapter of the Mages Guild.
Jode, also known as Mara's Tear, is the Aldmeri god of Masser. In the Khajiit religion, Jode is one of the aspects of the Lunar Lattice, or Ja-Kha'jay.

Jhunal, called the God of Runes, is the Nordic god of hermetic orders. He is often represented by an owl, a symbol rare to find among warlike Nords. By the Second Era, his worship was beginning to fade.. This is often attributed to a notion among Nords that anything that does not make one physically stronger is worthless, though the true reason may be due to his similarities with Herma Mora. He is absent in modern Nordic mythology. In the Ancient Nordic Pantheon, Jhunal was worshiped as the Owl, one of the Hearth Gods.
Jearl was a Redguard who lived in the city of Bruma during the final days of the Third Era. At some point, she joined the Order of the Mythic Dawn and became a Sleeper Agent in its service.

Janand Maulinie is a Breton Enchanter located in Vivec City, in the Mages Guild. She is an Enchantress, and in addition to enchanting services, she offers a selection of enchanted clothing, weapons, and armor for sale.

Jensine is a Nord who owns the shop Jensine's "Good As New" Merchandise, in the Imperial City Market District. She is also the head of the Society of Concerned Merchants, a merchant organization set up to allow for better trade amongst the merchants in the Market District. She also initiates the quest "Unfriendly Competition," which is about Thoronir and The Copious Coinpurse. She is angry because Thoronir offers exaggeratedly low prices, and she thinks his goods are stolen items.
Jesan Rilian is an Imperial member of the Kvatch guard, and, during the quest "Find the Heir," is seen defending the barricade between the Scamps and the innocent civilians.

Jirolin Doran is an Imperial commoner who lives in his home with his wife Ariela Doran. He wears a Coarse Linen Shirt, Laced Leather Pants, and a pair of Rough Leather Shoes. He also carries the key to his house and a small amount of .
Jerian Dolbanitte is a Breton commoner who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind.

Jiv Hiriel is an Imperial bard of Hackdirt and a member of the cult there. He will give information on how to find Dar-Ma, the missing girl from Chorrol, and a key to open the cage door. Jiv can be found in his home at night.
Jesan Sextius is an Imperial living in the western corner of Anvil. He is a singer, composer and storyteller. At night, Jesan can be located in his house.

Jastia Sintav is an Imperial who lives in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City with her sister Jena Sintav. She is a member of the Sintav clan, a family that is one of the most respected in the Imperial City and one that has a bit of a rivalry with the Atius clan. She can be found around the Elven District or visiting Iniel Sintav, the elder of the Sintav clan. She is a very middle class person, and carries a key to her house, which she shares with Jena.
Jena Sintav is an Imperial commoner who lives with her sister Jastia Sintav in their home in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City.
Jelin is a Redguard member of the Imperial Legion residing in Ebonheart.
Je Tee is a Nord warlock residing in Ald Daedroth, Antechamber.
Jolgeir is a Nord slaver residing in the cave of Saturan. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Jenassa is a Dunmer mercenary and a potential follower. She can be found in The Drunken Huntsman in Whiterun.
Jesper is a Nord miner. He is a resident of Stonehills, a small mining encampment, and works in the nearby Rockwallow Mine east of Morthal.

Jaree-Ra is an Argonian treasure hunter who works with his sister, Deeja. Jaree-Ra and Deeja are both the leaders of a group of criminals called the Blackblood Marauders. He can be found in Solitude, near Angeline's Aromatics. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "Lights Out!"
Jervar is a Nord farmer who can be found at the Whiterun Stables.
Jawanan is a Redguard who came from Hammerfell to Skyrim with the hopes to become a fletcher.
Jastira Nanus is an Imperial nightblade who resides on the Dementia side of Split. Jastira shares her identity with an alternate version of herself on the Mania side of town.
Jod is a Nord warrior serving as the Housecarl of Skald the Elder and the Guard Captain of the guard in Dawnstar.

Japhet was a warrior whose corpse can be found in the cellar of Japhet's Folly. The cellar can be found behind an expert-locked door at the bottom of the main tower. The room is full of spider webs. The Dragonborn can find Japhet's Journal, a leveled sword, and a master-locked chest next to his corpse. He was the son of a farmer and set out with a small company of men from Dawnstar to create a fortress which is now Japhet's Folly. The locals believed the island was haunted. Eventually, his followers left him one by one, but he refused to give up. He ultimately died in the cellar, convinced that the rumors about Japhet's Folly being haunted were true.
Januarius Aurunceia is a servant to the Count Marius Caro at the Castle Leyawiin in Leyawiin.
Jaras Invel is an Imperial located in Leyawiin, as one of the guests at the countess' party, along with his wife, Britta Invel.
Javolia Maborel is an Imperial commoner and a devout worshiper of Meridia who can always be found at Meridia's Shrine.
Jean-Pierre Lemonds is a Breton living in Bravil. He can normally be found in the inn Silverhome on the Water.
Jolie Retiene is a Breton who lives in Water's Edge with her husband Eduard Retiene, north of Leyawiin on the west bank of the Lower Niben River.
Jeanne is a Redguard trader in the Vivec, Foreign Quarter Canalworks. Jeanne's shop is named Jeanne: Trader. She and another shopkeeper, Balen Andrano, are in severe concurrence.

Jobasha is a Khajiit bookseller who owns and operates the Jobasha's Rare Books in the Foreign Quarter's Lower Waistworks of Vivec City. Guarded by an Ordinator sent by Duke Vedam Dren, Jobasha also owns Charles the Plant, which produces the rare ingredient Meteor Slime. He works closely with Ilmeni Dren, a noble of House Hlaalu and leader of the abolitionist Twin Lamps.
Jocien Ancois is a Breton Priest being held hostage by rogue Ashlanders in the Shashurari Camp.
Janonia Aurunceia is the Imperial head servant for the count and countess of Castle Leyawiin, where she also resides.

Jolda is a Redguard apothecary who sells all manner of alchemy supplies from her shop in Tel Mora. She has a grandmaster's mortar & pestle, and a master's calcinator and retort for sale. She is not involved in any quests and does not provide any unique information.
Jeanciele Macile is a Breton witchhunter who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.

Jiub is a Dunmer ghost who may be found in the Soul Cairn. In life, he was a prisoner in the boat which the Nerevarine took to Morrowind, and eventually became a saint. He died during the Oblivion Crisis, where his soul was captured by Mehrunes Dagon.
Jeleen is a Redguard priest residing at the shrine in Fort Frostmoth. He is an oracle of the Imperial Cult.
Jean Andre is a Breton mage who sells spells and creates spells at the Magic Shop in the Great Bazaar district of Mournhold.
Jodhur is a Khajiit commoner residing in the Great Bazaar, Mournhold. He is there to watch the play The Horror of Castle Xyr which is due to be played.

Jim Ward (May 19, 1959 – December 10, 2025) was an American voice actor who provided the voice for Mannimarco in . Some of his other work includes Dr. Klein in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Old World Blues, and Orsino in Dragon Age II. In 2021, Ward had to retire from acting as he was diagnosed with both COVID-19 and Alzheimer's. He died in 2025 due to complications from Alzeimer's.
Jeer-Maht is an Argonian Slave residing in Sha-Adnius east of Khuul.

Jo'Ren-Dar is an escaped Khajiit Slave who resides inside Sterdecan's Farmhouse, in the Ascadian Isles. As the course of the quest "Tul's Escape" suggests, he is in hiding with the abolitionist Sterdecan. As such, even though he still wears a bracer, there is no key and he cannot be freed by the Nerevarine as he is already free.
Jofnir Iceblade is a Nord who was the guildmaster of the Fighters Guild prior to Sees-All-Colors's tenure. Depending on which faction the Vestige joins, he will appear throughout the related regions.
Jilarga is a Khajiit laborer residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon. She can be found walking near the Vulkhel Guard Wayshrine.
Jesper Moret is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found at The Rosy Lion inn.
Jeran is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be located behind the Fighters Guild in town. He has chickens on his property and is cleaning after them all the time.
Jaylim is a Redguard alchemist who resides in the city of Port Hunding on the island Stros M'Kai. He sells his wares in the indoor market Doom and Draughts.
Jasper Litlin is a Breton member of the Lion Guard, residing in the Lion Guard Redoubt. He is found near the gates to the inner courtyard.
Jarina is a Redguard armsman residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood. She is a member of the Fighters Guild and can be found selling her wares in the local guildhall.
Jode's Chariot is a generic Khajiit guard residing in Redfur Trading Post, Grahtwood.
Janona Alielle is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Crosswych.
Jimy Gidric is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found at the Crosswych Inn, drinking.
Janese Lurgette is a Breton residing in Stormhaven. She is located near Nurin Farm.
Jeanylle San is a Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She's located in the Wayrest Regiment's Camp, just outside the northern gates of the town.
Jiluza is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is part of Telenger the Artificer's expedition taking place at Ezduiin.
Jernald Coravel is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Evermore.
Javerien Rambouze is a Breton mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Hallin's Stand. He can be found at the local branch selling his wares.
Jayeed is a Redguard residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Janne Marolles is a retired Breton adventurer. She is found with her companions at the Dro-Dara Plantation.
Jerissean af-Owlin is a Redguard clothier residing in the city of Wayrest.
Jofgrieda Brewmistress is a Nord brewer working at Deldwine's inn in Fort Amol.
Jin-Ei is an Argonian who resides in the Sulfur Pools, in the region of Stonefalls.
Jehannette Vinetier is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Shornhelm.
Joheric Garnier is a Breton residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Jareen is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm. Originally from Whiterun, she is in Windhelm as part of the Kornlunikar, and can be found in a mead-drinking contest.
Jeeba-Naza is an Argonian alchemist residing in the city of Windhelm. She is a celebrant of the Konunleikar. She has no unique dialogue.
Jarla af-Jahi is a Redguard brewer in who resides at the Rain Catcher Fields in the Alik'r Desert.
Jarning Mad-Eye is a Nord member of the Ember-Eye Slavers and the first mate of Captain Angarthal found aboard The Bloody Scupper.
Jarrod is a Redguard looking for his son Taren in the Ogre's Bluff.
Javerien Tustin is a Breton member of the Undaunted found at their enclave in Elden Root.
Javierre Mathierry is a Breton noble found in Daggerfall. She has taken the last sweetroll, much to the chagrin of Harcourt Rernis.
Jean-Jacques Alois is a Breton member of the Dragonstar Caravan Company. He is currently performing a contract consisting of escorting refugees out of Bangkorai.
Jeelus is an Argonian mage competing in The Summoner Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Jeelus-Lei is an Argonian guild trader selling her wares at the Lake Honrich Holdings in Riften.
Jeer-Tei is an Argonian member of the Jackdaw Pirates occupying Haven.
Jeetum-Tulm is an Argonian who can be found in the outlaws refuge beneath Stormhold.
Jelanan is a Redguard member of Captain Currod's crew found aboard The Tava's Bounty, docked in Koeglin Village in Stormhaven. He has no unique dialogue.
Jenna DuBois is a Breton found in Daggerfall. She can be found working in the Daggerfall Millworks. She has no unique dialogue.
Jerall Finstock is a Breton found in Hoarfrost Downs. He works there as a jewelsmith.
Jerard Larocque is a Breton noble attending to Count Hosni at-Tura's party at his estate.
Jerina is an Imperial held prisoner by the Scaled Court. She is one of many used to create Mantikoras.
Jilan-dar is a Khajiit weapons dealer. He was captured by the Toothmaul Tribe while hiding some of his merchandise away on the coast.
Jindra Frostbrow is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Skywatch.
Jofarr is a Nord drunkard found in the Hall of the Dead and then near the Windhelm Wayshrine in Windhelm.
Janieta Serpe is a Breton found inside Ufgel's Bathhouse and Laundry in Orsinium. She has no unique dialogue.
Jarak-dar is a Khajiit residing in Moonmont in the region of Reaper's March.
Jerian Valtieri is a Breton residing in the Barracks House in Wayrest. He is sheltering from the Dreugh attack.
Jee-Tul is an Argonian found in Anvil, Gold Coast. He can be seen near the entrance to Anvil Castle.
Jodis Windbite is a Nord enchanter and member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Anvil.
Jee-Ma is an Argonian guild trader selling her wares at her stall, Jee-Ma's Stash, in Orsinium.
Jeannine Carme is a Breton residing in the large house located near the bridge leading to Bangkorai.
Jeberilie Brousseau is a Breton found inside the castle in Daggerfall.
Jarredda is a Nord residing in Windhelm. She is a celebrant of the Konunleikar. She has no unique dialogue.
Jester King Jorunn is a Khajiit impersonating Jorunn the Skald-King in the Jester's Festival and acts as Festival Herald, located in southern Ebonheart.
Jester Queen Ayrenn is an Orsimer dressing as Queen Ayrenn in the Jester's Day Festival, and is located north of Vulkhel Guard's walls.
Jester King Emeric is an Argonian pretending to be High King Emeric in the Jester's Day Festival, and is located outside the walls of Daggefall.
Jeeba-Noo is an Argonian General Goods Merchant working at Jeeba-Noo's Portside Goods, a stall in Foundation's Labor in Vivec City.
Jeggming is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Jaree-Eeto is an Argonian slave located inside Khartag Point on Vvardenfell. He was one of the slaves seeking escape from slavers which used Khartag and his Ropefish gang as means to do so.
Jode's Chariot Guard is a generic Khajiit guard residing in the Redfur Trading Post, Grahtwood.
Jarl Hjurgol Skgoralmar is a Nord found within the Jarl's Hall of Falkreath Hold. He is the current Jarl of Falkreath, and the father of Thane Eerika Skjoralmor.
Jolha was an Umbrielian working in Phmer's kitchen. He was one of Phmer's assistants.
Jhiinval is a Redguard newcomer to Summerset held in a cage within the Undercroft Passage of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Chukka-Li is a drunk Breton residing in Anvil. Sometimes he can be seen fighting with Axkiral, Cidius or Chukka-Li in front of Enrick's Public House.
Jaxsik-Orrn is an agent of the Dead-Water Tribe. She seeks to terminate the Blackguard in Murkmire.
